SELECT
                    (@rownum := @rownum + 1) AS id,
                    StoreName,
                    date,
                    refunded_mode,
                    SUM(total_refunded_amt) AS total_refunded_amt
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        s.store_name AS StoreName,
                        DATE(ro.created_at) AS date,
                        arl.refund_mode AS refunded_mode,
                        SUM(arl.refunded_amt) AS total_refunded_amt
                    FROM has_products hp
                    JOIN return_orders ro
                        ON ro.order_id = hp.order_id
                    AND ro.prod_id = hp.prod_id
                    AND ro.has_product_id = hp.id
                    JOIN amount_to_be_refunded_log arl
                        ON arl.order_id = hp.order_id
                    AND arl.prod_id = hp.prod_id
                    AND arl.has_product_id = hp.id
                    JOIN orders o ON o.id = hp.order_id
                    JOIN order_stores os ON os.order_id = o.id
                    JOIN stores s ON s.id = os.store_id
                    WHERE
                        hp.return_mode = 3
                        AND os.store_id IN (1)
                        AND arl.refunded_amt > 0
                        AND ro.created_at  BETWEEN
                        '2026-11-16 00:00:00'
                        AND
                        '2026-11-16 23:59:59'
                    GROUP BY s.store_name, DATE(ro.created_at), arl.refund_mode

                    UNION ALL

                    SELECT
                        s.store_name,
                        DATE(arsl.refunded_at),
                        arsl.platform,
                        SUM(arsl.refunded_amount)
                    FROM orders o
                    JOIN order_stores os ON os.order_id = o.id
                    JOIN stores s ON s.id = os.store_id
                    JOIN has_products hp ON hp.order_id = o.id
                    JOIN automated_refund_sic_logs arsl
                        ON arsl.order_id = hp.order_id
                    AND arsl.product_id = hp.prod_id
                    WHERE
                        hp.return_mode = 2
                        AND os.store_id IN (1)
                        AND arsl.refunded_at  BETWEEN 
                        '2026-11-16 00:00:00'
                        AND
                        '2026-11-16 23:59:59'
                    GROUP BY s.store_name, DATE(arsl.refunded_at), arsl.platform
                ) combined
                CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) r
                GROUP BY StoreName, date, refunded_mode
                ORDER BY StoreName, date, refunded_mode;

SELECT
                order_summary.id AS id,
                StoreName,
                DATE(order_summary.created_at) AS date,
                COUNT(DISTINCT order_summary.id) AS total_number_of_bills,
                SUM(order_summary.tss_money_used) AS total_tss_money,
                SUM(order_summary.tss_points_used) AS total_tss_points,
                SUM(order_summary.coupon_amt_used) AS total_coupon,
                SUM(order_summary.voucher_amt_used) AS total_gift_voucher,
                SUM(order_summary.pg_disc) AS total_pg_disc,
                SUM(order_summary.total_cash) AS total_cash,
                SUM(order_summary.total_paytm_card) AS total_paytm_card_amount,
                SUM(order_summary.total_paytm_upi) AS total_paytm_upi_amount,
                SUM(order_summary.total_online_other) AS total_online_other,
                SUM(order_summary.online_payment) AS total_online,
                SUM(order_summary.district_transaction_amt) AS district_transation_amt,
                SUM(order_summary.credit_pincode_amt) AS credit_pincode_amt,
                SUM(order_summary.total_order_qty) AS total_order_qty
            FROM (
                SELECT
                  
                    o.id,
                      (SELECT
                            store_name
                        FROM
                            stores
                        WHERE
                            id = os.store_id) AS StoreName,
                    o.created_at,
                    o.tss_money_used,
                    o.tss_points_used,
                    o.coupon_amt_used,
                    o.voucher_amt_used,
                    o.pg_disc,

                    -- ✅ one value per order (cash)
                    (SELECT SUM(os2.offline_payment)
                    FROM order_stores os2
                    WHERE os2.order_id = o.id
                    LIMIT 1) AS total_cash,

                    -- ✅ one value per order (online_other_payment)
                    MAX(os.online_other_payment) AS total_online_other,
                    MAX(os.online_payment) AS online_payment,
                    -- ✅ FIXED: Paytm Card per order (aggregated to prevent duplication)
                    COALESCE((
                        SELECT SUM(ppt.amount)
                        FROM pos_paytm_transactions ppt
                        WHERE ppt.order_id = o.id
                        AND ppt.is_active = 1
                        AND ppt.platform = 'txn_completed'
                        AND ppt.payment_mode = 1003
                        AND ppt.store_id IN (1)
                    ), 0) AS total_paytm_card,

                    -- ✅ FIXED: Paytm UPI per order (aggregated to prevent duplication)
                    COALESCE((
                        SELECT SUM(put.amount)
                        FROM pos_paytm_transactions put
                        WHERE put.order_id = o.id
                        AND put.is_active = 1
                        AND put.platform = 'txn_completed'
                        AND put.payment_mode = 1004
                        AND put.store_id IN (1)
                    ), 0) AS total_paytm_upi,

                    SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN os.district_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND os.district_transaction_id != ''
                        THEN os.online_other_payment ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS district_transaction_amt,
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN os.credit_pincode_id IS NOT NULL AND os.credit_pincode_id != ''
                        THEN os.online_other_payment ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS credit_pincode_amt,
                    -- ✅ Exact match to raw query: count of has_products rows
                    COUNT(hp.id) AS total_order_qty

                FROM orders o
                JOIN order_stores os ON os.order_id = o.id
                JOIN has_products hp ON hp.order_id = o.id   -- force INNER JOIN
                LEFT JOIN pos_paytm_transactions cppt
                    ON o.id = cppt.order_id
                AND cppt.is_active = 1
                AND cppt.platform = 'txn_completed'
                AND cppt.payment_mode = 1003
                LEFT JOIN pos_paytm_transactions uppt
                    ON o.id = uppt.order_id
                AND uppt.is_active = 1
                AND uppt.platform = 'txn_completed'
                AND uppt.payment_mode = 1004
                WHERE os.store_id IN (1)
                -- ❌ Remove this filter if you want *exact* count as simple query
                AND o.order_status NOT IN (0, 1, 4, 17)
                AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-16 23:59:59'
                GROUP BY o.id, o.created_at,
                        o.tss_money_used, o.tss_points_used,
                        o.coupon_amt_used, o.voucher_amt_used, o.pg_disc
            ) AS order_summary
            GROUP BY order_summary.StoreName, DATE(order_summary.created_at)
            ORDER BY order_summary.StoreName, DATE(order_summary.created_at);
